items.title: Walmart (WMT) Debuts Predictive Precision Targeting At Sam's Club
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) unit Sam's Club has introduced Predictive Precision Targeting to support first party data-driven advertising for brands. The new Sam's Club capability is pitched as offering measurable performance insights for advertisers using member shopping and engagement data. Walmart and several large retailers are facing scrutiny in 2026 for scaling back diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives across their operations.
